cs.t: I recently just set this up for my 5 year old. I bought a Grandstream HandyTone 801 as a bridge. I use voip.ms as a service provider. Both are geared toward more technical users, but the service is very reasonable for the price. Instructions for configuring it are clunky but not too bad:  https://wiki.voip.ms/article/Grandstream_HandyTone_802_-_HT8... . I had previously tried Ooma, but I didn't like that it wanted to sit between my router and modem.
